context:
Goal: the fresh start begins soon, on a main whose CI finishes.
Problem (goal): three fixes started today are not in the named queue, and waiting for all three would delay the drain's end, so which must land first is your call.
Based on (measured): main's CI has finished no push run since Nov 9; 11 runs were cut by the Windows guard 20-minute limit (#2591 raises it to 75).
Based on (read): #2591 has passed all review and waits for the batch; #2593 (the CI-done wake) passed round 3 and is in lint; the mailbox fix #2552 needs a main merge and 3 review rounds.
Departs from: main R23, drain only the named queue — adds: the drain ends without #2593 and #2552, which go into the new sessions' handoffs; #2591 lands first.
Meanwhile: all three lanes run on; nothing waits on this.

options.gain: New sessions start soon, and main's CI finishes for them.
options.how: #2591 lands before the archive; #2593 and the mailbox fix go into the handoffs.
options.label: Only #2591 first (Recommended)
options.lose: The cloud CI-done wake and the Windows mail fix land a little later, under new sessions.

options.gain: Everything started today lands before the restart.
options.label: All three first
options.lose: The restart waits on the mailbox fix's main merge and three review rounds.

reply: You answered in chat at 12:55 CST (relayed by the coordinator): "yes land #2591 before archive". #2591 lands before the archive; #2593 (the CI-done wake) and the mailbox fix carry over in the new sessions' handoffs if they have not landed. Home: restart plan 5dba413.
short: Which of today's three fixes must land before the restart?
title: Three fixes started today are not in the named queue. Must any besides #2591 land before the restart?
why: Waiting on all three delays the fresh start.
